entities.name: Orwell
entities.description: Village bell-ringer from Gatstaf in Kessig, ritualistically murdered by Bes Palter.

entities.name: Bes Palter
entities.description: Murderer who arranged Orwell's body parts to help summon Ormendahl.

entities.name: Ormendahl
entities.description: Demon Bes Palter sought to summon.

entities.name: Gatstaf
entities.description: Village in Kessig where Orwell lived.

events.summary: Bes Palter ritualistically murdered Orwell and arranged his body parts to help summon the demon Ormendahl.
Halana and Alena discovered Orwell's corpse and realized a different kind of murderer was loose, as he had not been eaten.
events.quote: But as Orwell had not been eaten, they realized a different type of murderer was loose in the village as well.
